# Zed - AI Workspace

Zed is an AI-powered dashboard with intelligent agents, model management, plugins, and computer automation.

## Features

- [AI Agents](/agents) - Create and manage AI agents with custom skills
- [Model Management](/models) - Connect and configure AI models
- [Plugins](/plugins) - Integrate with Gmail, Google Drive, Notion, and more
- [Scheduled Tasks](/scheduled) - Automate recurring workflows
- [Computer Mode](/computer) - Browser automation with live streaming
- [Voice Agents](/voice) - Create voice-based AI agents

## API

- `/api/*` - Backend API endpoints
- `/v1/*` - LLM proxy endpoints
- `/oauth/*` - OAuth authentication endpoints
